headline: Landis Hospitality and Resorts: Domestic travel subsidy launches in September, adding market momentum - Liberty Financial
summary: Landis Hospitality and Resorts said first-half 2026 revenue set a same-period record and profits grew substantially. The company expects stable operations and cited a domestic travel subsidy launching in September.
why: Landis Hospitality and Resorts is a Taiwan-listed hotel and resort operator whose earnings depend on tourism demand.
